course.title: Physical Metallurgy of Materials
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: You are a materials engineer at a company specializing in the manufacturing of high (15) performance steel components for the automotive industry. Your team is working on two projects:
(i)Developing a new steel alloy for heavy-duty truck axles.
(ii) Producing a set of gears for high speed transmissions.
Demonstrate the factors affecting the hardenability of steel alloys for both projects. Include relevant diagrams to support your analysis.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
